selection_method: Up to two reviewable non-launcher episodes per task at approximately one-third and two-thirds of that task's reviewable episode sequence; action-only exceptions are retained with warnings.
limitations: Intent and specificity labels are provisional until the original task-library metadata is recovered or reviewed.
The dataset's recorded task outcomes determine whether outcome strata vary; sampling cannot manufacture absent outcome classes.
Website domain is a reproducible proxy for website type and should be collapsed into researcher-defined site categories before inferential analysis.
